candidates.intent_rationale: Travellers involved in a crash, or worried about one, hear that foreigners can be barred from leaving Vietnam until the police finish or compensation is settled, and want to know how real that risk is, what the law actually lists and what to do first.
candidates.content_angle: Sets the advisories side by side: the FCDO says foreign nationals involved in traffic accidents have been stopped from leaving Vietnam until police investigations ended and have been asked to agree out-of-court financial settlements, while Canada lists motor vehicle accidents among the matters behind exit bans and mentions a travel ban until compensation is paid. Against them stands the Vietnamese foreign ministry's August 2024 statement rejecting a British press report on exit bans and passport seizure, so the sources differ and the Writer must present both sides. The Writer then reads the grounds that the Law on the Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners lists for suspending exit and the authorities that may decide, plus Article 83 of Law 36/2024/QH15 on accident investigation, quotes them with article numbers and dates, checks the reader's own foreign ministry advice, repeats the practical advice (professional legal help, contact the embassy, cooperate with the police) and never predicts that a given accident will or will not lead to a ban. It complements the first-steps guide, which mentions the travel-ban warning only in one paragraph, by examining the question on its own.
candidates.working_title: Can You Be Stopped From Leaving Vietnam After a Road Accident? What Travel Advice and the Law Say

candidates.intent_rationale: Reisende, die in einen Unfall verwickelt waren oder sich davor sorgen, hören, dass Ausländer Vietnam nicht verlassen dürfen, bis die Polizei fertig ist oder der Schadenersatz geregelt ist, und wollen wissen, wie real dieses Risiko ist, was das Gesetz tatsächlich aufführt und was sie zuerst tun sollten.
candidates.content_angle: Stellt die Reisehinweise nebeneinander: Das britische Außenministerium schreibt, Ausländer, die in Verkehrsunfälle verwickelt waren, seien an der Ausreise gehindert worden, bis die Polizei ihre Ermittlungen beendet hatte, und seien um außergerichtliche finanzielle Einigungen gebeten worden; Kanada nennt Kraftfahrzeugunfälle unter den Anlässen für Ausreisesperren und erwähnt ein Reiseverbot bis zur Zahlung der Entschädigung. Dagegen steht die Erklärung des vietnamesischen Außenministeriums vom August 2024, die einen britischen Pressebericht über Ausreisesperren und eingezogene Pässe zurückwies; die Quellen widersprechen sich, und der Autor muss beide Seiten darstellen. Der Beitrag ergänzt den Ratgeber zu den ersten Schritten, der die Warnung vor Ausreiseverboten nur in einem Absatz erwähnt, indem er die Frage eigenständig untersucht.

candidates.intent_rationale: Reizigers die bij een ongeluk betrokken waren of daar bang voor zijn, horen dat buitenlanders Vietnam mogelijk niet mogen verlaten tot de politie klaar is of de schadevergoeding geregeld is, en willen weten hoe reëel dat risico is, wat de wet echt opsomt en wat ze eerst moeten doen.
candidates.content_angle: Zet de reisadviezen naast elkaar: het Britse ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken schrijft dat buitenlanders die bij verkeersongevallen betrokken waren, zijn tegengehouden bij het verlaten van Vietnam tot de politie het onderzoek had afgerond en dat hun is gevraagd in te stemmen met financiële schikkingen buiten de rechter, terwijl Canada motorvoertuigongevallen noemt onder de aanleidingen voor uitreisverboden en een reisverbod tot betaling van de schadevergoeding vermeldt. Daartegenover staat de verklaring van het Vietnamese ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken van augustus 2024, dat een Brits krantenbericht over uitreisverboden en ingenomen paspoorten verwierp; de bronnen verschillen en de schrijver moet beide kanten tonen. Daarna leest de schrijver welke gevallen de wet op binnenkomst, vertrek, doorreis en verblijf van buitenlanders noemt voor het opschorten van vertrek en welke instanties mogen beslissen, plus artikel 83 van wet 36/2024/QH15 over ongevalsonderzoek, citeert ze met artikelnummer en datum, controleert het advies van het eigen ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken van de lezer, herhaalt de praktische adviezen (professionele juridische hulp, ambassade inschakelen, meewerken met de politie) en voorspelt nooit dat een bepaald ongeluk wel of niet tot een verbod leidt. Het vult de gids over de eerste stappen aan, die de waarschuwing voor uitreisverboden maar in een alinea noemt, door de vraag apart te onderzoeken.

candidates.content_angle: Coloca os avisos lado a lado: o ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros britânico escreve que estrangeiros envolvidos em acidentes de viação foram impedidos de sair do Vietname até a polícia concluir as investigações e foram convidados a aceitar acordos financeiros extrajudiciais, enquanto o Canadá inclui os acidentes com veículos a motor entre as causas das proibições de saída e menciona uma proibição de viajar até ao pagamento da indemnização. Do outro lado está a declaração de agosto de 2024 do ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros vietnamita, que rejeitou uma notícia da imprensa britânica sobre proibições de saída e apreensão de passaportes: as fontes divergem e o autor deve apresentar as duas versões. Depois lê que casos a lei de entrada, saída, trânsito e residência de estrangeiros enumera para suspender a saída e que autoridades podem decidir, bem como o artigo 83 da lei 36/2024/QH15 sobre a investigação de acidentes, cita-os com número de artigo e data, verifica os avisos do próprio ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros do leitor, repete os conselhos práticos (aconselhamento jurídico profissional, contactar a embaixada, cooperar com a polícia) e nunca prevê que um acidente concreto leve ou não a uma proibição. Complementa o guia dos primeiros passos, que só refere o aviso sobre proibição de saída num parágrafo, ao examinar a questão por si.
candidates.working_title: Proibição de sair do Vietname após um acidente de viação: o que dizem os avisos de viagem e a lei

candidates.intent_rationale: 교통사고를 겪었거나 걱정하는 여행자는 외국인이 경찰 수사가 끝나거나 배상이 합의될 때까지 베트남을 떠나지 못할 수 있다는 이야기를 듣고, 그 위험이 얼마나 현실적인지, 법이 실제로 어떤 경우를 나열하는지, 무엇부터 해야 하는지 알고 싶어 합니다.
candidates.content_angle: 여행 경보를 나란히 놓고 비교합니다. 영국 외무부는 교통사고에 연루된 외국인이 경찰 수사가 끝날 때까지 베트남을 떠나지 못했고 법정 밖 금전 합의에 동의하라는 요청을 받았다고 쓰고, 캐나다는 자동차 사고를 출국 금지의 원인 가운데 하나로 꼽으며 배상이 끝날 때까지 출국이 금지될 수 있다고 언급합니다. 이에 맞서 베트남 외교부는 2024년 8월 영국 언론의 출국 금지·여권 압수 보도를 거짓 정보라며 반박했으므로 출처가 엇갈리고, 작성자는 양쪽을 모두 제시해야 합니다. 그다음 외국인 입국·출국·통과·거주법이 출국 보류 사유로 열거하는 경우와 결정할 수 있는 기관, 사고 조사에 관한 법률 36/2024/QH15 제83조를 조문 번호와 날짜와 함께 인용하고, 독자 본국 외교부의 안내를 확인하며, 실용적 조언(전문 법률 조력, 대사관 연락, 경찰 수사 협조)을 되풀이하되 특정 사고가 금지로 이어질지 여부는 절대 예측하지 않습니다. 이 글은 출국 금지 경고를 한 문단으로만 언급하는 사고 직후 첫 단계 가이드를 보완해 이 질문만 따로 살펴봅니다.

2015年刑事訴訟法

candidates.intent_rationale: 交通事故に遭った旅行者や、事故を心配する旅行者は、外国人が警察の捜査が終わるか賠償が決まるまでベトナムを出国できないことがあると聞き、そのリスクがどれほど現実的なのか、法律が実際にどんな場合を挙げているのか、まず何をすべきかを知りたがっています。
candidates.content_angle: 各国の渡航情報を並べて対比します。英国外務省は、交通事故に巻き込まれた外国人が警察の捜査が終わるまでベトナムを出国できず、裁判外の金銭的な和解に同意するよう求められたことがあると書き、カナダは自動車事故を出国禁止の原因の一つに挙げ、賠償が済むまで出国が禁じられる可能性に触れています。これに対し、ベトナム外務省は2024年8月に、英国メディアの出国禁止とパスポート押収の報道を虚偽の情報として退けたため、情報源は食い違っており、執筆者は両方の立場を示す必要があります。そのうえで、外国人の入国・出国・通過・居住に関する法律が出国の一時停止の理由として挙げる場合と決定できる機関、事故調査に関する法律36/2024/QH15第83条を条文番号と日付付きで引用し、読者の本国の外務省の案内も確認し、実務的な助言（専門的な法的支援、大使館への連絡、警察への協力）を繰り返し、特定の事故が出国禁止につながるかどうかを予測してはいけません。この記事は、出国禁止の警告を一段落でしか触れていない事故直後の最初の対応の案内を補い、この問いを単独で検討します。
candidates.working_title: ベトナムで交通事故後に出国を止められることはあるか：渡航情報と法律の内容
